notaEditor.title: Practice Studio
notaEditor.subtitle: Record short melodic ideas with the selected makam, usul and instrument, then review the notation and save them to the archive.
notaEditor.workflowSetupBody: Choose the makam, usul and instrument you want to play.
notaEditor.workflowRecordBody: While recording is on, press the instrument surface or a MIDI keyboard.
notaEditor.workflowReviewBody: Listen to the timeline, check the notation and keep the score.
notaEditor.setupDescription: These choices are saved with the take and set the playback sound.
notaEditor.captureBody: Every pressed note is stored with its timing while recording is active.
notaEditor.surfaceDescription: Fast melody entry with the selected instrument sound.
notaEditor.emptyOutputBody: When recording starts, pressed notes appear here as a timeline and standard notation.
notaEditor.timelineDescription: Listen to the captured durations, stop playback or clear the take.
